purpose: private authored activity pilot; not learner-facing

activities.cueEnglish: Find where the crew marked a 10-by-10-foot test square.
activities.modelFrench: Sur le versant ouest, ils ont marqué un carré d’essai de dix pieds sur dix.
activities.modelEnglish: On the roof slope that faces west, they marked a test square of 10 by 10 feet.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name the adjuster in French.
Listen and identify the French term for the roof slope.
activities.modelEnglish: the roof slope (one face of the roof)

activities.cueEnglish: Type 'Mark each hit with chalk.' in French.
activities.modelFrench: Marquez chaque impact à la craie.

activities.cueEnglish: Ask the adjuster to repeat the measurements more slowly.
activities.modelFrench: Rogelio : « Pardon, pouvez-vous répéter plus lentement ? »
activities.modelEnglish: Rogelio: Sorry, can you repeat that more slowly?

activities.cueEnglish: Write what the adjuster says will happen to the west and north sides.
activities.modelFrench: L’expert : « Selon la compagnie d’assurance, le côté ouest sera remplacé entièrement et le côté nord sera réparé. »
activities.modelEnglish: Adjuster: According to the insurance company, the west side gets fully replaced and the north side gets repaired.

activities.cueEnglish: Find the homeowner's request about the underlayment.
activities.modelFrench: Mme Flores : « Et pour économiser, posez les bardeaux sans la sous-couche. »
activities.modelEnglish: Mrs. Flores: And to save money, put the shingles on without the underlayment.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name the manufacturer warranty in French.
Listen and identify the French term for thunder.
Type 'Don't go up until I say so.' in French.
activities.modelFrench: Ne montez pas avant mon autorisation.
activities.modelEnglish: Don't go up until I say so.

activities.cueEnglish: Tell Mrs. Flores why Rogelio cannot omit the planned underlayment.
activities.modelFrench: Rogelio : « Nous ne pouvons pas supprimer la sous-couche prévue; vérifions les exigences du système et de la garantie. »
activities.modelEnglish: Rogelio: We cannot skip the planned underlayment; let's check this system's and warranty's requirements.

activities.cueEnglish: Write the condition Rogelio puts on temporary tarping.
activities.modelFrench: Rogelio : « Une protection temporaire par bâche pourrait être envisagée seulement quand les conditions sont sûres et selon le plan approuvé. »
activities.modelEnglish: Rogelio: Temporary tarping could be considered only when conditions are safe and under the approved plan.

activities.cueEnglish: Find what Julio says caused the uneven course.
activities.modelFrench: Julio : « Je crois que je n’ai pas mesuré depuis la dernière ligne et que j’ai travaillé à l’œil. »
activities.modelEnglish: Julio: I think I didn't measure from the last line and I did it by eye.

activities.cueEnglish: Without looking, name the exposure in French.
activities.modelEnglish: the exposure (visible part of the shingle)

activities.cueEnglish: Listen and identify the French term for alignment.
Type 'What happened here, in your view?' in French.
activities.modelFrench: Que s’est-il passé ici, à ton avis ?
activities.modelEnglish: What happened here, in your view?

activities.cueEnglish: Ask Julio to look at the course with you in private.
activities.modelFrench: Rogelio : « Julio, je voudrais que tu regardes ce rang avec moi, en privé. »
activities.modelEnglish: Rogelio: Julio, I want you to look at this course with me, in private.

activities.cueEnglish: Write what Julio agrees to remove and reinstall.
activities.modelFrench: Julio : « D’accord, je vais déposer ces quatre rangs et les reposer. »
activities.modelEnglish: Julio: All right, I'll take off these four courses and put them back on.
